mail_kind.instructions: What kind of email this is for its recipient, Herb Caudill (herb@devresults.com), owner of DevResults. Judge the message itself, using the sender, subject, body and whether it carries bulk-mail headers.

personal.covers: A message a person wrote to Herb or to a small group including him: colleagues, clients, partners, friends and family, including replies in an existing conversation.
personal.excludes: Mass mail made to look personal, and cold pitches from strangers.

cold_outreach.covers: Unsolicited one-to-one style pitches from people or firms Herb has no relationship with: software or service sales, lead generation, recruiting, job seekers, investors, brokers, acquisition inquiries, event or award solicitations.
cold_outreach.excludes: Replies to something Herb started, and mail from companies he already buys from.

marketing.covers: Bulk promotional mail from a company or organization: sales and discounts, product or feature announcements, webinars and events, upgrade or upsell offers, loyalty and rewards promotions, app tips, re-engagement, feedback and review surveys, fundraising appeals, and company newsletters whose purpose is to promote the sender.
marketing.excludes: Receipts, account notices, alerts and editorial writing, even when they come from the same company.

editorial.covers: Newsletters whose main content is writing, journalism, analysis or commentary that Herb subscribed to read, such as a writer's Substack or a news outlet's editorial newsletter.
editorial.excludes: Company newsletters promoting the company's own products, events or offers.

transactional.covers: Mail about a specific transaction or account action: receipts, invoices, statements, payment confirmations or reminders, bookings and reservations, shipping, renewals, one-time codes, verification and password-reset messages.
transactional.excludes: Promotions that only mention an account.

notification.covers: Automated alerts about Herb's own accounts, systems, groups or activity: security alerts, monitoring and service status, calendar invitations and responses, shared documents, comments, mentions, mailing-list or group posts, and changes to terms or service.
notification.excludes: Promotional mail dressed up as an alert.

government.covers: Mail from a government agency or official public body, including tax, labor, licensing and public-service notices and newsletters.
government.excludes: Private companies that work with government.

cold_type.instructions: If this message were an unsolicited pitch to Herb, which kind of pitch it would be.

criteria.cold_vendor: Selling software, services, consulting, recruiting services, lead generation, payroll, financial products or similar offerings.
criteria.cold_job_inquiry: A job seeker, résumé, freelancer looking for work, or recruiter introducing a candidate.
criteria.cold_investor: An investor, private-equity firm, broker, funding pitch or acquisition inquiry.
criteria.generic_solicitation: A generic solicitation, repeated cold follow-up, unsolicited promotional event, pay-to-play award or vanity-publication offer.

needs_attention.instructions: As of evaluatedAt, this message gives Herb a current, material reason to notice it soon: a direct personal message, an explicit request, decision, approval or deadline for him, a cancelled or changed meeting, a concrete security incident on his account, a production failure, bounced mail or failed payment, a medical result or action, an unusual charge or other financial exception, an imminent cancellation or loss of service, or a concrete problem or assignment in active work. Routine receipts, statements, confirmations, newsletters, promotions, one-time codes and digests that repeat old events are not reasons.

criteria.true: There is a current, material reason for Herb to notice this message soon.
criteria.false: The message is routine, promotional, informational or out of date.

attention_reason.instructions: If Herb needs to notice this message, the main reason why.

criteria.personal_message: A direct personal message or meaningful message from an active correspondent.
criteria.explicit_action: A current request, decision, approval, deadline or other action explicitly required from Herb.
criteria.scheduling_exception: A declined or cancelled meeting, proposed new time, missing meeting link, delivery failure or similar scheduling exception.
criteria.account_security: A completed or attempted security-sensitive event such as a risky sign-in, new device, password or authentication change, or account recovery.
criteria.operational_failure: A current production failure, bounced outgoing mail, failed payment, service interruption or similar operational exception.
criteria.medical_action: Current medical results, prescriptions, treatment changes or healthcare actions.
criteria.financial_anomaly: An overdraft, reversal, unexpected account change, unusual charge or other current financial exception.
criteria.service_decision: An approaching cancellation decision, missing payment details, imminent loss of service or similar time-sensitive service choice.
criteria.active_work: A meaningful update in active work with a concrete decision, problem or assigned action.

routine_authentication.instructions: This message is only a one-time password, access or verification code, magic or sign-in link, or account registration message, and it does not report a concrete security event such as a risky sign-in, new device, credential change or account recovery.

criteria.true: Only a routine code, link or registration message.
criteria.false: Something else, or it reports a concrete security event.
